title: SRD 5.1 importer: equipment / weapon / armor parser
description:
**Prerequisites (apply to all SRD 5.1 importer child issues):**
- Vendored SRD 5.1 PDF must be in place at `packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf` — see that directory's README.md.
- Reference implementation: mirror the structure of `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseSpells.ts` (parser), `emit.ts` (record builder + manifest description), `index.ts` (pipeline wiring), and the test layout under `packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/`.
- Depends on `loreweaver-0m9.5.9` (section detection + orchestrator) — run parsers over narrowed page slices, not the full PDF.

---

Add a parser for SRD 5.1 equipment, weapons, and armor (kind=equipment). Handles weapon tables (damage dice, properties, weight, cost), armor tables (AC, type, strength requirement, stealth disadvantage), and adventuring gear.

Note: SRD 5.1 presents weapons/armor as tabular data, not stat-block prose. The parser will likely need to detect the weapon/armor tables specifically and project rows into per-item records — different shape from the spell parser. Re-use the kindSchema baseline; weapon-specific fields (damageDie, damageType, properties[], weight, cost) and armor-specific fields (ac, armorType, stealthDisadvantage, strengthRequirement) go in data.
acceptance_criteria:
- Parser extracts every equipment entry from the SRD equipment section (weapons table, armor table, adventuring gear table).
- Records satisfy dnd5e-srd equipment baseline kindSchema.
- Weapon table rows are normalized into per-weapon equipment records with structured weapon fields in data.
- Armor table rows are normalized into per-armor equipment records with structured armor fields in data.
- Manifest description includes 'equipment' in Included record kinds.
- Unit tests cover a simple weapon (dagger), a martial weapon (longsword), light/medium/heavy armor (leather, scale mail, plate), and a piece of adventuring gear (rope).
close_reason: Implemented SRD 5.1 equipment/weapon/armor/gear parser; PR #102 open for review (https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/102). All quality gates green.
